body.x: Bench Soft (CEO Lee Dong-hun) unveiled an iPhone smartphone case and a USB memory product with X-Link technology at “CES (Consumer Technology Show) 2016”, the world’s largest IT electronics and tech exhibition, which runs for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th in Las Vegas.

The “XI.i.CON Case” for iPhones is a smartphone case with a magnetic adaptor. The product has both D+/D- of USB standards and a 2-pin power cable at four main contact points, making it simple and easy to connect iPhones to PCs, audios, and automobiles that support USB interfaces.

“Xl.i.CON Flash Memory” is a USB memory product that can be connected to iPhones via the “XI.i.CON Case”. It transmits data via a magnetic-type port, instead of an insert-type one. CES recognized Bench Soft's remarkable tech idea and bestowed upon it the innovation award.

“CES”, which is held every year in January by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics exhibition, showcasing global trends in the electronics and IT industry. AVING News, which has sent reporters to CES for 11 years, will introduce various up-to-date technologies and products showcased at CES 2016. Based on keen reports and research at CES, AVING News will hold the “CES 2016 Review Conference” at Korea AVING Studio on Wednesday the 28th.
